summary.intent: Run the GSD manager to discuss, plan, and execute three gap-closure phases (42: API unpin integrity, 43: FUSE write durability, 44: IPNS conflict handling) discovered during a UAT audit of PR #484 for the CipherBox v1.1 milestone.
summary.outcome: Phases 42 and 43 were fully planned, executed (wave-based parallel worktrees), code-reviewed, and verified. Phase 43 required a gap-closure sub-cycle and produced a UAT file for 4 runtime-only items. Phase 44 reached the research stage at session end.

repo: POST /ipfs/unpin is JWT-only with no ownership check — any account holder can unpin any CID. The handler passed the incoming CID string directly to Kubo pin/rm without reading req.user.
Kubo v0.40 runs with the 'server' profile and swarm port 4001 exposed publicly, meaning pinned CIDs are advertised to the public DHT and harvestable by crawlers — CIDs are not private identifiers.
Writable-share saves drop prunedCids without calling unpin (shared-write.ts:450) — no legitimate cross-user unpin path exists in the application.
BYO-IPFS advisory row removal is client-side only and broken in both directions; new server-side guardedUnpin semantics fixed BYO for free ('not pinned' swallowed gracefully).

pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test -- --testPathPattern=X BREAKS because pnpm inserts an extra '--', causing jest to treat the flag as a positional regex. Use: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api exec jest --testPathPattern='X'
1Password SSH commit signing requires dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true on all git Bash calls; signing failures require the user to restart the 1Password desktop app.
The gsd commit helper returns 'committed: false' as a false negative even when the commit landed — always verify with git log, never blind-retry.
cleanup-wave is not idempotent: aborts on the first blocked entry, and already-merged worktrees report 'branch_mismatch' on rerun. Write reduced manifests containing only remaining unmerged entries.
cleanup-wave must be run from the repo root, not from within an agent worktree — it resolves repoRoot from cwd, causing false 'base_mismatch' errors when invoked from the wrong directory.
Node.js multi-glob rm (rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules) aborts entirely if any glob misses — use single explicit paths instead.

Windows WinFsp cross-compilation fails on macOS due to pre-existing issues in the windows-future and winfsp-sys registry crates; cargo check on macOS project crates passes but cargo build -p cipherbox-fuse --features winfsp does not.

prettier was mangling .planning/ markdown (VALIDATION.md regex pipes became table columns) because no .prettierignore existed. Created .prettierignore to exclude .planning/, .claude/gsd-core/, and related GSD-controlled paths.
The gsd decision-coverage gate requires a literal 'D-07:' citation string in the plan's must_haves section — mechanical grep will miss paraphrased references.

code.finding: Upload-compensation path fires a global pin/rm on a CID that content-addressed dedup may share with another user — same cross-tenant destruction surface as the direct unpin endpoint. Fixed by routing through guardedUnpin.

guardedUnpin added: pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)) → transactional row-delete + refcount + pending_unpins outbox insert → Kubo pin/rm post-commit best-effort. Cross-user attempts emit audit metric and return silent 2XX.

Had a journal.remove call after upload_content success, creating an orphan window before parent-pointer publish. Fixed to use mechanism (b): removal gated on per-file IPNS publish success, matching the POSIX path's CR-08 treatment.
New PendingUnpin entity (@Entity('pending_unpins')) with unique cid index and no userId — the outbox is CID-scoped, not user-scoped, reflecting that Kubo pins are global.
Full rewrite to implement durable WriteQueue with JournalOp enum, fsync barrier before ack, ordered replay by created_at_ms, and failure recording with retry cap. Previous code had no persistence.

Kubo v0.40 with server profile and swarm port 4001 tcp+udp exposed publicly. Server profile only disables local-network discovery, not public DHT participation — pinned CIDs are broadcast as provider records.

workflow: GSD execute-phase wave pattern: each plan runs in an isolated git worktree (Agent with isolation=worktree), manifest JSON tracks worktree paths/branches, cleanup-wave merges back after all wave executors complete.
Post-merge gate must target specific test suites (never full monorepo) due to RAM constraints. Pattern: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/<pkg> exec jest --testPathPattern='<pattern>'.
TDD gate verification: confirm RED commit (failing spec) appears before GREEN commit (implementation) in git log for each TDD-marked plan.

When a gap-closure sub-cycle is needed (verifier finds gaps), the pattern is: spawn gap planner → plan-checker → commit gap plans → execute gap plans in additional waves → re-verify. This extends the phase rather than closing prematurely.
openapi.json can accumulate formatting-only drift from nest build side-effects in the main worktree; restore with git checkout -- before wave merges to prevent spurious conflicts.
When a merge leaves MERGE_HEAD (all conflicts auto-resolved but commit step failed), conclude it with git commit --no-edit then manually remove the worktree and delete the branch.
The gsd-tools query commit helper should be treated as unreliable for confirming success — always follow up with git log to verify the commit actually landed before retrying.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failures mid-session required user intervention to restart the desktop app, blocking all git commits until resolved.
gsd commit helper false negatives caused repeated retry attempts and confusion about whether commits actually landed.
Planner socket error ('socket connection was closed unexpectedly') after writing plans 01-03 for Phase 42 required filesystem fallback and a continuation planner spawn.
cleanup-wave not being idempotent caused cascading failures when rerun after partial completion — required writing reduced manifests with only remaining entries.
pnpm test forwarding '--' to jest broke testPathPattern usage; discovered mid-execution when gate commands silently ran against wrong test files.
openapi.json formatting drift from nest build side-effects required manual restore before wave merges to prevent spurious merge conflicts.
42-05 merge left MERGE_HEAD state requiring manual git commit --no-edit to conclude, plus manual worktree removal and branch deletion.
Decision coverage gate failure (D-07) required adding a literal citation string to plan 42-03 after gates had otherwise passed.
Session quota interruptions at critical points (mid-wave-3 for Phase 42, mid-wave-5 for Phase 43) required resume and state reconstruction.
User had to correct assistant behavior twice: once for presenting menus without directly answering questions, once for accidental 'touring wyatt web bossy' inputs disrupting execution flow.
No .prettierignore existed, causing prettier to mangle planning markdown files (regex pipes became table columns in VALIDATION.md).
Node multi-glob rm command aborted entirely when one glob pattern missed, blocking worktree cleanup until rewritten with explicit paths.
